headline: PIT @ STL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is PIT 3.61 at STL 4.61, with a projected total of 8.23. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward STL: PIT moved -0.43 runs while STL moved +1.07, changing the projected margin by -1.51 runs. The projected total climbed +0.64, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -22.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Michael McGreevy has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.2 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Iván Herrera, Spencer Horwitz, Alec Burleson, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Victor Scott II because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
